mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 9.5% for two consecutive months signals economic distress, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 100), weak corporate earnings cause S&P 500 underperformance, leading to negative returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth above 2.5% signals inflation concerns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent payroll growth above 100k per month (PAYEMS) supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer spending (RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars) indicates robust retail activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline for 1 month.
